name: store a durable fact (producer; leaves it alive for the recall/forget consumer)

turns.user: remember that my default editor is neovim
turns.description: T1 — an explicit store (a 'remember that X is Y' trigger, not a bare declarative the router only offers on). It must route via the memory path AND the durable facts store must gain a row: the runner's memory-write-gap check HARD-fails if the facts store stays empty after this producer runs (the dogfood 'zero facts despite a whole conversation' failure — a green transcript that stored nothing). cleanup=false intentionally leaves the fact alive for MEM-recall-forget-01, which takes responsibility (cleanup_for) for sweeping it.
assertions: an explicit remember-that routes to the memory store path
